moto-gloves-boom.name: ★ Moto Gloves | Boom!
moto-gloves-boom.desc:
These bulky hard knuckled gloves can protect the wearers hands from road rash at 60 mph. This pair has been covered in comic book onomatopoeia.

POW! BOOM! BIFF!

specialist-gloves-chocolate-chesterfield.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Chocolate Chesterfield
specialist-gloves-chocolate-chesterfield.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

broken-fang-gloves-jade.name: ★ Broken Fang Gloves | Jade
broken-fang-gloves-jade.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.

ak-47-vulcan.name: AK-47 | Vulcan
ak-47-vulcan.desc: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted in a sports inspired design.

ak-47-predator.name: AK-47 | Predator
ak-47-predator.desc: Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.

bayonet-damascus-steel.name: ★ Bayonet | Damascus Steel
bayonet-damascus-steel.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has some damascus steel parts.

pp-bizon-fuel-rod.name: PP-Bizon | Fuel Rod
pp-bizon-fuel-rod.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted to give the illusion of irradiated ammo.

Sometimes grunts have the upper hand

pp-bizon-jungle-slipstream.name: PP-Bizon | Jungle Slipstream
pp-bizon-jungle-slipstream.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been custom painted with a green and yellow hydrographic.

Follow the leader

pp-bizon-anolis.name: PP-Bizon | Anolis
pp-bizon-anolis.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. A green and black hydrographic lizard scale pattern has been applied.

Painted to scale

pp-bizon-water-sigil.name: PP-Bizon | Water Sigil
pp-bizon-water-sigil.desc: The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been painted using a hydrographic with a Japanese inspired water pattern.

cz75-auto-polymer.name: CZ75-Auto | Polymer
cz75-auto-polymer.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. The slide has been given a decal that resembles a polymer formula.

You're not dealing with The Phoenix anymore, we know how to take care of our own... - The Daughter and the Paladin Part 2

dual-berettas-hemoglobin.name: Dual Berettas | Hemoglobin
dual-berettas-hemoglobin.desc: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted using a transparent red abstract hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

dual-berettas-emerald.name: Dual Berettas | Emerald
dual-berettas-emerald.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent emerald anodized effect paint.

This is what the great Sebastien Hennequet has been reduced to? A nagging school marm?  What happened to you... - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 2

dual-berettas-briar.name: Dual Berettas | Briar
dual-berettas-briar.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a hydrographic of curling vines and flowers.

True Love's Kiss can't save you from its barbs

five-seven-violent-daimyo.name: Five-SeveN | Violent Daimyo
five-seven-violent-daimyo.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with a graphic design in violet and black.

How will you rule?

five-seven-urban-hazard.name: Five-SeveN | Urban Hazard
five-seven-urban-hazard.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been custom painted with urban camo and red accents.

Every year, Booth gathers the worlds foremost designer gunsmiths to show off their latest designs

five-seven-dark-polymer.name: Five-SeveN | Dark Polymer
five-seven-dark-polymer.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. This custom paint job makes the weapon look like it is made of a transparent purple polymer.

Wrapped in a purple candy shell

galil-ar-rocket-pop.name: Galil AR | Rocket Pop
galil-ar-rocket-pop.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been custom painted with a graphic design of stripes and pixellated particles.

The perfect thing for a hot summer's day

glock-18-twilight-galaxy.name: Glock-18 | Twilight Galaxy
glock-18-twilight-galaxy.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with an old-fashioned racing motif.

Don't forget your helmet

glock-18-water-elemental.name: Glock-18 | Water Elemental
glock-18-water-elemental.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with the image of a creature made of water in a graphic style.

glock-18-bullet-queen.name: Glock-18 | Bullet Queen
glock-18-bullet-queen.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. Menacing bullets and a War Maiden in a pink jacket have been custom painted over a yellow and black base.

"I'll stop shooting when you start shushing"

glock-18-catacombs.name: Glock-18 | Catacombs
glock-18-catacombs.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted using a hydrographic of skulls over a silver metallic paint base.

Intimidation is the sincerest form of flattery

glock-18-fully-tuned.name: Glock-18 | Fully Tuned
glock-18-fully-tuned.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted using neon colors and metallic glitter paint.

It's a bit much for me, but I'm not the target audience... - Booth, Arms Dealer

p2000-pathfinder.name: P2000 | Pathfinder
p2000-pathfinder.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been spray-painted with a stencil of an isometric labyrinth.

Personally I prefer the 4th edition, but the customer is always right - Booth, Arms Dealer

butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Gamma Doppler
butterfly-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

butterfly-knife-rust-coat.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Rust Coat
butterfly-knife-rust-coat.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

paracord-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

paracord-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Forest DDPAT
paracord-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

classic-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Classic Knife | Forest DDPAT
classic-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

gut-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Gut Knife | Doppler
gut-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Gut Knife | Gamma Doppler
gut-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

navaja-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Night Stripe
navaja-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

karambit-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Karambit | Tiger Tooth
karambit-tiger-tooth.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

karambit-urban-masked.name: ★ Karambit | Urban Masked
karambit-urban-masked.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

m9-bayonet-bright-water.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Bright Water
m9-bayonet-bright-water.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

nomad-knife-night-stripe.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Night Stripe
nomad-knife-night-stripe.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been spray-painted with a tape mask pattern in a night ops color scheme.

Spray... Pray... Paint... Stab.

shadow-daggers-damascus-steel.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Damascus Steel
shadow-daggers-damascus-steel.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has some damascus steel parts.

bowie-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Ultraviolet
huntsman-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

ursus-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Doppler
ursus-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

talon-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Talon Knife | Slaughter
talon-knife-slaughter.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

talon-knife-scorched.name: ★ Talon Knife | Scorched
talon-knife-scorched.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

m4a4-griffin.name: M4A4 | Griffin
m4a4-griffin.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been hand-painted with an illustration of a griffin.

Felix handpicked his team from operators all over the world... and while people question their personalities, they never question the results

m4a4-red-ddpat.name: M4A4 | Red DDPAT
m4a4-red-ddpat.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painted using a red Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m4a1-s-fade.name: M4A1-S | Fade
m4a1-s-fade.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

m4a1-s-hyper-beast.name: M4A1-S | Hyper Beast
m4a1-s-hyper-beast.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with a beastly creature in psychedelic colors.

You really want to impress me Booth? Make this black light sensitive - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

mac-10-commuter.name: MAC-10 | Commuter
mac-10-commuter.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been painted with a plaid hydrographic and partly wrapped in faux crocodile leather.

They took the bait, let's move... - Elliott Kingsman, Mercenary

mag-7-navy-sheen.name: MAG-7 | Navy Sheen
mag-7-navy-sheen.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. An anodized navy blue VariCamo pattern has been applied.

Why so blue?

mag-7-petroglyph.name: MAG-7 | Petroglyph
mag-7-petroglyph.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted to give the illusion of a rock craving.

Conflict existed since the first caveman learned how to pick up a rock – Booth, Arms Dealer

mp7-just-smile.name: MP7 | Just Smile
mp7-just-smile.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. The blue and purple base coat is finished with a smiley face and the words "Just Smile" in yellow.

"Say cheeeeese"

mp9-bioleak.name: MP9 | Bioleak
mp9-bioleak.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. Varying shades of green create the illusion of a chemical spill.

BEWARE DIRECT EXPOSURE

p250-valence.name: P250 | Valence
p250-valence.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted in a modern blue and grey design that complements the weapon's form.

Your skills aren't in question, your attitude is - The Teacher and The Iconoclast Part 1

p250-constructivist.name: P250 | Constructivist
p250-constructivist.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted with a maroon and grey pattern.

Form AND function

p250-modern-hunter.name: P250 | Modern Hunter
p250-modern-hunter.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.

p250-kintsugi.name: P250 | Kintsugi
p250-kintsugi.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A striking orange bird and gold accents have been custom painted over an ivory-colored base.

Like those fancy dinner plates, this weapon's only used for special occasions

p90-shapewood.name: P90 | Shapewood
p90-shapewood.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. The wooden stock has been hand-carved, sanded, and laminated.

Tweezers not included

p90-attack-vector.name: P90 | Attack Vector
p90-attack-vector.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a multicolored abstract design.

Aggressive angles of attack

r8-revolver-canal-spray.name: R8 Revolver | Canal Spray
r8-revolver-canal-spray.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been spray-painted with short, diagonal bursts of blue paint.

You're mostly water anyways…

sawed-off-wasteland-princess.name: Sawed-Off | Wasteland Princess
sawed-off-wasteland-princess.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. Someone has been keeping track of kills on the barrel.

A perfect gift for the sociopath that has everything...

scar-20-poultrygeist.name: SCAR-20 | Poultrygeist
scar-20-poultrygeist.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been spray-painted with a pattern depicting chickens on a battlefield.

A chicken rides a shark into battle...

sg-553-traveler.name: SG 553 | Traveler
sg-553-traveler.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted in a stripe design inspired by vintage luggage, and had some parts wrapped in brown leather.

Everyone has a story, and Javier will pry it out before he kills you

tec-9-toxic.name: Tec-9 | Toxic
tec-9-toxic.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted with a garish hydrographic pattern of nuclear skulls and bones.

xm1014-banana-leaf.name: XM1014 | Banana Leaf
xm1014-banana-leaf.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A green and yellow hydrographic pattern of overlapping leaves has been applied.

Blood on the leaves

bayonet.name: ★ Bayonet
bayonet.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan.

shadow-daggers.name: ★ Shadow Daggers
shadow-daggers.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two.
